digest.obtained_by: docker pull python:3.12-slim && docker inspect python:3.12-slim --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'

changes.description: Both FROM python:3.12-slim lines replaced with digest-pinned FROM python@sha256:401f6e1a67dad31a1bd78e9ad22d0ee0a3b52154e6bd30e90be696bb6a3d7461 plus leading comment
New file: digest update process instructions (when/how/where/test)
New file: 6 unit tests for Dockerfile digest pinning correctness

gate_check_spec.name: r3_docker_base_digest_pinned
gate_check_spec.check: Parse packaging/docker/Dockerfile; for every non-comment FROM line, assert the image reference contains '@sha256:' followed by exactly 64 hex characters.
gate_check_spec.pass_condition: All FROM lines contain '@sha256:<64-hex-chars>'; no floating tags present.
gate_check_spec.remediation: Run: docker pull python:3.12-slim && docker inspect python:3.12-slim --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'. Replace both FROM lines in packaging/docker/Dockerfile with the output.
